cell_state_mapping.input: Single-cell or single-nucleus expression in H5AD, exact Ensembl IDs, and a checkpoint-compatible log1p and maximum-scale transform after the preprocessing discrepancy is resolved.
cell_state_mapping.native_output: Per-gene 200-dimensional merged_decodings, not a predeclared scalar cell embedding or classifier.
cell_state_mapping.required_project_output: A frozen cell representation and identical common-lane head; pooling cannot be chosen from held-label performance.
cell_state_mapping.row_universe: Use the identical eligible GSE289173 snRNA rows and frozen five-class ontology as every sealed cell-state candidate if exposure ever clears.
cell_state_mapping.split: All cells, nuclei, libraries, tissues, aliquots, timepoints, and modalities from one person remain in one donor outer fold.

conditional_masld_model.reason: No weight, output, or derivative terms were detected, and the encoder corpus is exposure-unknown.

perturbation_response.reason: The repository's GEARS directory trains a separate perturbation system on the Norman dataset. It is not a capability of the base checkpoint alone.

input_and_missingness_firewall.preprocessing: Do not choose between the paper's raw-count transform and the embed script's already-log1p assumption using held performance. Freeze one checkpoint-compatible path through development-only fixtures.
input_and_missingness_firewall.gene_identifiers: Map project identifiers one-to-one into the exact selected_genes_27k.txt Ensembl order only after that payload is hashed. Version suffixes, duplicates, aliases, and unmapped genes receive explicit states.
input_and_missingness_firewall.zero_fill: Model-list genes absent from the assay cannot be treated as assayed zero without an observed mask. Preserve structural absence outside the native tensor.
input_and_missingness_firewall.mean_fill: The released embed helper mean-fills representations for input genes absent from the model list. Those rows are derivations, not measured or model-native gene embeddings, and cannot silently enter pooling.
input_and_missingness_firewall.quality: Reject nonfinite values, unresolved normalization, incompatible gene coverage, and unsupported assay topology before model execution.

fit_and_selection_firewall.common_lane: Freeze the exact checkpoint and all auxiliary hashes, preprocessing, gene order, merged_decodings field, pooling, missingness, common head, label budget, folds, seeds, early stopping, and calibration before screening.
fit_and_selection_firewall.native_lane: No head, adapter, LoRA, or full fine-tune without written checkpoint and derivative terms. Report any later native result separately from a frozen probe.
fit_and_selection_firewall.held_donors: Held and sealed donors cannot set preprocessing, identifier mappings, pooling, gene inclusion, head architecture, exclusions, calibration, or thresholds.
fit_and_selection_firewall.labels: The sealed GSE289173 labels remain evaluator-only; commit standardized predictions before joining outcomes.
fit_and_selection_firewall.replication: Donors are inferential units. Cells, nuclei, genes, expression elements, seeds, and perturbations are not independent donors.

runtime_and_loading_firewall.pickle: Both the .pth checkpoint and .pkl hyperparameter object can execute code during deserialization. No direct load is permitted.
runtime_and_loading_firewall.isolation: After written terms and immutable hashes, inspect in a disposable no-network runtime without credentials or mounted project data, then convert approved tensors and plain parameters only if derivative terms permit.
runtime_and_loading_firewall.environment: The README recipe and sclong.yml conflict, sclong.yml mixes CUDA 11.8 components with cuda-version 12.5, and embed.py contains an author-local absolute path. A rebuilt immutable L40S environment is required.
runtime_and_loading_firewall.memory: Full 27,874-gene by 200 output for a one-billion-parameter model requires a measured batch and memory contract. Published source defaults do not establish L40S viability.

rules.all_unknown_fail_closed: Every target source remains unknown until checkpoint bytes, upload and training cutoff, and the full accession, release-alias, donor, retained-cell, label-use, and deduplication roster are bound together.
rules.filename: A timestamp-like checkpoint filename is not an immutable object date or proof of nonexposure.
rules.archive: The exact Zenodo source archive does not contain or license the separately hosted checkpoint and auxiliary payloads.
rules.source_owned_results: Published perturbation, drug-response, GRN, and integration evaluations are prior work and separate downstream fitted systems.

claim_boundary.current: No execution, MASLD cell-state champion, sealed external claim, perturbation champion, or conditional-model contribution.
claim_boundary.future_comparator: If exact bytes, written terms, corpus, preprocessing, pooling, runtime, and capability gates clear, scLong may enter as a restricted frozen cell-state comparator.
claim_boundary.clinical: No diagnostic, prognostic, treatment-response, or deployment claim.

interpretation: scLong is scientifically relevant because it models all 27,874 genes using high- and low-expression Performer paths and GO-informed gene embeddings. It is not executable for this campaign. The checkpoint and four required payloads lack read-only hashes and terms, the official folder is inaccessible, preprocessing and cell pooling are ambiguous, all Atlas exposure is unknown, and the released runtime conflicts internally.
